name: clawd
description: Clawd's HQ: Clawd lives in a pixel art office, mimes what Claude does, and a game HUD shows the model, context and rate limits

hauteur.title: Terminal height
hauteur.description: Maximum height of the office in the terminal, in rows (10 to 54); never taller than the pane has room for, the whole room is scaled to fit

largeur.title: Terminal width
largeur.description: Maximum width of the office in the terminal, in columns (20 to 192); the whole room is scaled to fit the pane, keeping its proportions

resolution.title: Terminal resolution
resolution.description: mini: the office drawn in characters (cells and glyphs, Clawd as the CLI logo), clean in any small pane. hd: the full pixel art room, scaled down. auto: hd while it fits at half size or more, mini otherwise

fuseau.title: Time zone
fuseau.description: For the window sky, the wall clock and reset times, e.g. Europe/Paris; empty = TZ or the machine zone
